data.one_liner: Dio interceptor for automatic token refresh and retry on API failures
data.what_it_does: Provides a Dio interceptor that intercepts failed requests, triggers a token refresh callback using a singleton token manager, and retries the original requests. It also proactively validates tokens before requests are sent.
use_when: Your Flutter app uses Dio for HTTP requests and requires automatic OAuth token refreshing.
You need to handle concurrent 401/403 errors cleanly by sharing a single refresh lock.
avoid_when: You are not using the Dio HTTP client.
Your backend does not implement a token refresh endpoint.
strengths: Automatic token refresh and request retrying on API failures
Handles concurrent failures with a shared refresh lock to avoid duplicate refresh calls
Supports custom token validation and header generation
weaknesses: Tight coupling to the Dio HTTP client package
Uses a singleton TokenManager pattern which may limit multiple distinct auth sessions

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: You can implement custom interceptor logic manually without adding a dedicated refresh package.
